notices.title: The Fallen Stars playtest is coming soon!
notices.body:
Thank you for your interest in Fallen Stars!
· The playtest starts soon. We will announce it here when the downloads open.
· Then choose the Windows or Android version at the top of this page; the steps are under "How to install".
· During the test, numbers and content may change at any time, and there will sometimes be maintenance. Maintenance is announced here and in the game beforehand.
· Found a bug, got stuck, or felt something was too hard or too easy? Please send it with Feedback in the game's Settings; a screenshot helps a lot.
Stay tuned!
notices.bodyZh:
感谢关注《落星》！
· 测试即将开始，开放下载时会在这里通知。
· 到时在本页上方选择 Windows 或 Android 版本，安装步骤见「安装说明」。
· 测试期间，数值和内容可能随时调整，偶尔也会维护。维护会提前在这里和游戏内公告。
· 遇到 bug、卡关，或者觉得哪里太难、太简单，请多多使用游戏「设置」里的「反馈」，附上截图更好。
敬请期待！
